record_type_quote: We used the code and datasets published by the authors (Hussam et al., 2022b) to reproduce the tables in their paper.

targets.authors: Hussam, R., N. Rigol, and B. Roth
targets.title: Targeting High Ability Entrepreneurs Using Community Information: Mechanism Design in the Field
targets.evidence_quote: In this short paper, we replicate their main findings, conduct some robustness checks, and test hetero- geneity of results by gender.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: We were able to reproduce all the tables in the paper, which is not surprising given that the codes had already been checked by the American Economic Review replication team and by the team of the Institute for Replication.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Overall, we conclude that our replication of the results in Hussam et al. (2022a) is successful. Re- sults are computationally reproducible and robust to different treatment of outliers, to excluding surveyor and survey month fixed effects and to different splits of the average rank distribution of entrepreneurs.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All original tables were reproduced before correction. Authors judge the conclusions robust to tested alternatives and the minor coding correction; exploratory gender heterogeneity is an extension.

reasoning: The same original data and code are re-analysed. One target is the 2022a finding article; 2022b is its data-and-code companion, not a separate original. The article target DOI is not printed in the text.
